title: Absolutely wonderful!
text:
The experience that Victoria provided was second to none! She was the biggest reason for our vacation in Barcelona being a lasting memory. I would certainly want her to be my guide for a future visit.

Request her if you can!
author: Mark_W

title: Great tour. Our guide...
text: Great tour. Our guide Horatio was very knowledgeable and took us to great restaurants and sights. Would highly recommend.
author: Kenneth_S

title: Excellent tour with Alan
text: Alan was Fantastic! He worked with our arrival time and had everything coordinated for our food, drinks and the Sagrada Basilica. He was super informative about the city and we enjoyed everything he had to share with us about Barcelona and our sights
author: heather_w

title: Today was a great day!
text: What an amazing day! Horacio Angel was a fantastic guide. He brought us to several eateries the locals go to and we got to sample the Barcelona cuisine. He explained the history of Catalonia, Barcelona and the Roman time. We walked through several neighborhoods and got to see the diversity of the city. It was great to see Bacelona as Barcelonians see it. Horacio was knowledgeable and funny. It was a great day and if you are lucky, you'll get Horacio as your guide.
author: Bill_B

title: A taste of Barcelona
text: This experience was extraordinarily wonderful. Jennifer was awesome. Her knowledge of the city was incredible. Her personality and understanding of art was exceptional. We were spent by the time we reached the second or third tapas, which was as tasty as the first. Best experience ever! This was definitively an excellent and unparalleled taste of Barcelona for sure!
author: Hyacintha_B

title: Fun tour with a great guide and great food!
text: Jennifer was a wonderful guide and we felt more like we were walking around the city with a friend than a tour guide. She took us to places we would have never explored on our own.
author: Patricia_F

title: Great Barcelona tour if you want to see how the locals live
text:
Alan is very personable, and knowledgeable. His knowledge of Barcelona and it's history is fantastic. His use of a map is brilliant to walk you through the ages of the city. 
The food was amazing and he knows everyone. He also listens to what you want, and caters the tour as best he can.
author: Mark_M

title: My mom and I had a great...
text: My mom and I had a great time with our private tour guide, Brunella. One piece of advice is to come to the tour hungry! We were able to walk around and get to know the city and it's beautiful architecture all while trying out new drinks and tapas. Brunella was very knowledgeable about all sorts of topics which made the tour enjoyable and we were able to ask her a lot of questions that you might not get in a larger tour group. Thanks again!
author: Jordyn_D

title: Great selection of gastro...
text: Great selection of gastro pubs. Excellent pinchos and tapas. Simon our guide was excellent. The sights and sounds in the market place was unforgettable.
author: Sean_P

title: Awesome food tour with Catalonian guide Oriol!
text: Awesome tapas and sangria with our native Catalonian tour guide Oriol! He took us to places we never would have found and my favorite part was just listening to him ask questions and order for us. We do not speak Spanish so we could not have done this on our own!
author: Kevin_G
